# Retro PSX Nature Pack (Elegant Crow) — licence

All files in this folder come from the **Retro PSX Nature Pack** by **Elegant Crow**:
<https://elegantcrow.itch.io/retro-psx-nature-pack>

**No explicit licence text found on the itch.io page as saved** (`DOWNLOAD_PAGE.html` in the candidate library is
the download page, not the asset page, and contains no licence, "CC0", "Creative Commons" or "commercial" wording).
The pack's `READ ME.txt` states no licence either — it only thanks the downloader and links the artist's
donation/social pages:

> Thank you so much for downloading my assets!
> Consider supporting me and helping me to make more of these
> Donations: https://www.buymeacoffee.com/elegantcrowcg

The candidate-library index lists the pack as **CC0** — **verify on the live asset page before release** and
replace this note with the quoted licence text. Until then treat it as: free download, attribution
("Elegant Crow") recommended, commercial use unconfirmed.
